_comment: Multi-step variant of test_04: same FLOW -> RCL -> Pressure topology but with number_of_time_pts=5 (4 internal 0D steps per external step). The legacy single-step get_dP_dQ formula is wrong for this regime — only the LAST internal step's sensitivity is captured, missing propagation through the prior 3. The new forward-sensitivity recursion in Integrator::step accumulates dy_N/dQ correctly across all 4 internal steps. RCL added so the response is time-dependent (pure R has dP/dQ = R independent of N, masking the bug).
